title: EBV-CAN
caption: Implemented EBV-CAN architecture. (a) Initial-EBV patch features are cached, projected, and combined with fixed two-dimensional positional encodings. (b) EV history, the repeated current-state embedding, and current-image CNN features produce $h_t$; the text encoder produces $z_l$. (c) Both condition all three learned queries. Two residual cross-attention blocks read the fixed memory. (d) The action head concatenates $h_t$ with all three final query tokens and predicts six two-motor commands; only the first is executed. The auxiliary coordinate head uses only the tip token. C denotes concatenation; CLS denotes the class token. Q, K, and V denote query, key, and value; WP and Tgt denote waypoint and target. Input thumbnails are representative.
walkthrough_zh:
- **(a) 缓存全局空间记忆（Cached Global Memory）**：初始全局鸟瞰图（Initial EBV，$448\times 336$）经冻结 DINOv2 ViT-S/14 提取 $24\times 32$ 个 384维 Patch 特征，经 LayerNorm、线性投影（$384\to 256$）并叠加 2D 位置编码后，缓存为固定全局记忆矩阵 $G \in \mathbb{R}^{768\times 256}$ 作为键值对 $(K,V)$。
- **(b) 动态条件编码（Dynamic Conditioning）**：语言指令 $l$ 经词嵌入与 GRU 池化生成语义向量 $z_l$；近8帧内镜视图（EV）的冻结 DINOv2 CLS 特征与 MLP 编码的电机状态 $s_t$ 拼接后输入导航 GRU，再与当前 EV 帧的 CNN 特征融合投影为 256维动态导航特征 $h_t$。
- **(c) 三查询空间接地（Three-query Grounding）**：引入尖端（Tip）、下一导引航点（WP）与指令目标（Tgt）三个可学习查询，按 $Q^0 + W_h h_t + W_l z_l$ 注入动态条件后，经2层4头残差交叉注意力读取全局记忆 $G$，输出空间接地表征 $Q^2 \in \mathbb{R}^{3\times 256}$。
- **(d) 动作预测与辅助监督（Action Prediction）**：Tip Token 单独经 MLP（$256\to 2$）回归尖端坐标 $(\hat{x},\hat{y})$ 提供显式空间监督；$Q^2$ 的三个 Token 与 $h_t$ 拼接为 1024维向量，经动作 MLP（$1024\to 12$）预测未来6步双电机指令（插入与弯曲），闭环仅执行首步动作 $a_{t:1}$。
